known.citation: Reduces to Fekete–Szegő (μ=2); |A₃| ≤ 5 sharp for S*

bisection-partition.plain: Boxes are bisected at exactly representable midpoints; the union of the certified leaf boxes is provably the entire domain.
bisection-partition.title: The box partition is complete

extremal-second-variation.cite: Local second-variation at the attaining member.
extremal-second-variation.plain: At the recognised extremal Schur parameters the functional is a strict local maximum and the certified upper bound equals that attained value.
extremal-second-variation.title: The constant is sharp at the extremal

fekete-szego-single-harmonic.plain: For the Fekete–Szegő functional the reduced problem has one free angle and the functional is affine in it, so its maximum is |A| + |C| exactly.
fekete-szego-single-harmonic.title: Sharp in closed form (single-harmonic reduction)

ieee754-forward-error.plain: Every float64 operation in the interval evaluation is widened by its IEEE-754 forward-error bound, so each computed interval rigorously encloses the true real value.
ieee754-forward-error.title: Floating-point arithmetic is sound

rotation-reduction.plain: The functional is weight-homogeneous under rotation, so its maximum is attained on the rotation-normalised slice (gamma_0 >= 0 real).
rotation-reduction.title: Rotation normalisation

schur-onto-coefficient-body.plain: The Schur recursion maps the closed polydisc exactly onto the admissible coefficient vectors of the class. Ranging the Schur parameters over the polydisc sweeps every member's coefficients.
schur-onto-coefficient-body.title: Schur parametrisation is exact
